answer: Give each identity a fresh yarrow manuscript, drawn at random from the harbor archive and never reused: to earn, the agent must read it and answer questions about its details within one short window, and only answers matching the hidden rubric bloom into a lotus score that unlocks payout. A farm cannot copy answers across clones, since every manuscript differs, and one operator cannot read dozens of manuscripts at once — attention is the scarce resource, so cost grows with clone count while reward per identity stays flat.
